$comment: Immutable Core Hub token contract. A subsystem MUST validate every field listed here.
jwksFormat: RFC 7517 - the response body MUST be {"keys":[...]} with no wrapper

sso.$comment: Central SSO, standards 1.1 (auth-contract.md section 5). Every sign-in starts at the subsystem's login path; the browser is sent to Core Hub's WEB app, never to the API's ssoAuthorizePath, which needs a Bearer header a redirect cannot carry.

claims.sub: Core Hub user id - the only identity a subsystem may trust
claims.role: Core Hub core role (student | alumni | staff | lecturer | guest | admin)

mustReject: unknown kid after one JWKS refresh

plannedChanges.next: aud will become the subsystem name (for example: student-service). Subsystems SHOULD accept a list of audiences during the transition. Moved out of 1.1, which delivered silent re-SSO instead.
plannedChanges.v2.0: The SSO handoff becomes authorization code + PKCE, so the access token no longer travels in the callback URL.
